notes.title: Available the 5th Patch for QC update!
notes.content:
After the release of two major patches three months apart, it might be time for the next one to be more modest to keep up with the pace. But getting to the point, let's start with what it offers:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/84b4566b5249b8c65a604a0d5f15206f40ca9084.png[/img]

The highlight of the patch and one of the most requested for a long time, is the ability to configure both the game's graphics and audio from the start menu (something that was only possible from the pause menu during the game). This can be accessed by pressing the "settings" button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/1861ed8db541a582095b0d94b406c9bfd5a306de.png[/img]

When accessed, the buttons we saw in the pause menu will be displayed, except that they are larger and have representative icons for each one.

Among other changes and additions:

[b]Physics and Gameplay Changes[/b]:
[list]
[*]Air movement will no longer stop while sprinting is active
[*]Input lag is significantly reduced when the character stops while sprinting
[*]Further improvements to sprint physics during startup
[*]Net-points from levels 1-2 that are behind glass walls will no longer be collectible
[/list]

[b]Other Changes[/b]:
[list]
[*]Minor improvements to the Quantum City boss battle
[*]Improved accuracy when detecting input from callout icons
[*]The sprint bar can be hidden while the character is in mid-air
[*]Minor audio fixes
[*]Scene change buttons will no longer be executed at the same time as the quit buttons in the pause menu
[/list]

Although in theory it should be continuing with the major update, this patch has been released because 
it's been a year since its Early Access release. In the meantime, please wait patiently for the major update 
throughout the remainder of [b]2025[/b] [i](unless there's some other strange reason to push out another patch as soon as possible)[/i].

notes.title: 4th Patch for QC Update!
notes.content:
In case you haven't noticed, in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2881270/view/524206779663385334?l=english]previous patch[/url] I said it was going to be the last one and polished enough to be worth waiting for the [b]next major update[/b]. However, as time has passed and after several unforeseen events, I've discovered once again that I was wrong. Furthermore, as I'm writing this,
the mechanics and some of the content for the next update are already in the prototyping phase, but since it still has a long way to go before it's released [i](whether due to interruptions or any other factor that requires more time)[/i], I've decided to take the opportunity to share what the next patch offers:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/28492adda8ad0a1a25ef625dd208610155836286.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/bcd93dc7aec4960699d41547154690b122ad7eaf.gif[/img]

One of the most notable additions is the ability to punch while Randy is sprinting.
This consists of an extension of his attacks that allows him to perform a ranged hit without much interruption to his speed. This will make it easier to defeat more than one enemy at a time, and it makes parts like the 102-brick challenge in levels 1-4 a slightly less tedious task.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/0ff95407764f020b0fda794feaa9e4fe7e0d11fe.png[/img]
[h3]Before[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/664d4b1e2a4928d88583efbcdba98e71a74938f0.gif[/img]
[h3]After[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/7a0ffebb99cfca6ee0aef2071c19ee99589a9410.gif[/img]

Another issue that was difficult to fix is ​​that, in levels with sloping terrain, the physics didn't behave correctly regarding the character's orientation. If you look on the up side of the image, when Manilla stops or runs again, she either goes up in the air or takes a while to fall, while on the down side, the physics are now more in line with the slope of the ground [i](although she still has that issue, but not as noticeable)[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/2d47568b78cbf2685b34303aa2b543bf4d9fffe5.gif[/img]

A very similar application has also been introduced in the 2D version. As Manilla runs down the slopes,
instead of falling from the air, she lands on the ground [i](in most cases)[/i], as seen in the example gif,
which provides a close-up of the physics of the reference game [i](Sonic the Hedgehog)[/i].
One issue that couldn't be resolved is that jumping while running on the same slope doesn't actually increase her height.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/7f4dafee5ba20bb5cd81d2288fd53105cd885055.png[/img]

Some revisions have also been made to some interfaces related to points and some supplementary text. It may not have seemed necessary at first to add backgrounds to the example texts, as they are generally perfectly legible without them, but sometimes there are moments in the game where the colors stick to the text, rendering it illegible. Therefore, readability has been improved, as in this example:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/ea77894595eb502d030d621f5961a484c5f3fa2f.png[/img]

The idea of ​​adding backgrounds to the text [i](although they may not seem the most aesthetically pleasing option)[/i] was to make all the text in the game as legible as possible.

Among many other changes and additions:

[b]Physics and Gameplay Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Minor bug fixed in the [b]Rol & Rogue[/b] boss battle when one chooses the fireball instantly or accidentally on controllers
[*] Minor collision fixes on double walls in Rol & Rogue levels
[*] When starting a sprint, one is much less likely to get knocked into the air
[/list]

[b]Other Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Cracksom's claws now leave trails to make the attack more visually noticeable during his boss battle 
[i](among other minor changes)[/i]
[*] When Randy hits [b]Koogamer's ship[/b], he is briefly stunned instead of taking damage
[*] Score texts no longer overlap [i](unless they appear at the same time)[/i]
[*] The default camera position has been changed in some levels
[*] Animal signs have been added to [b]Terra-Qubit[/b] levels 1-3 and 1-4
[*] Fixed a minor calculation error in level 6-1 where it said he won 400 points, when it was actually 200
[*] More layer adjustments in dialog commands
[*] The portal in [b]Quantum City[/b] doesn't appear when it's not time to exit the Net-Cube and opens when it is
[*] Corrupted boxers can hit faster after taking damage
[/list]

Truthfully, updates in the [b]patch[/b] category usually don't take more than a month to release, but this time it wasn't because it was harder to find any notable changes worth uploading [i](unless it was for serious bugs)[/i]. And, as with the third patch, it's here to provide the most polished experience possible while we wait for the big update. This one likely won't arrive in [b]2025[/b] due to the potential challenges it might cause, and if it's delayed to [b]2026[/b], we'll compensate by combining it with the second update to deliver the final version of [b]Randy & Manilla[/b] all at once. 
In the meantime, enjoy the current version ;)

notes.title: A great Randy & Manilla patch to start 2025!
notes.content:
As a reminder, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2881270/view/535462971004944654?l=english]previous patch[/url] was very small due to development being on hold for Christmas. To kick off [b]2025[/b], a much larger patch has been released, offering the following changes and additions:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/e975459917aedee6e06de141a4835b45e475119d.png[/img]

For starters, a small counter with a number has been added to Manilla's runner levels, indicating
how many jumps are left before landing again. This will make it easier to manage jumps while Manilla is in the air in order to complete the aforementioned levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/82611c3f4ac47decccfd3dcf6b739ff304f6d1ce.png[/img]

In addition, some strange details that have been overlooked for a long time have also been fixed, such as a piece of cloud with invisible edges in level 4-2 of Wonder Race, visible in the game trailers.

Among many other changes:
[list]
[*] Time now freezes while pausing during super sprint
[*] Fixed parts where exiting to start menu from pause would result in black screen
[*] Revamped tag trigger system
[*] Changed third clue text in Blue Quantáramo's passwords level
[*] Minor correction to level 4-4 ranking
[*] Corrections to Sparky's dialogue trigger in Rol & Rogue
[*] Minor camera corrections
[*] Changes to the physics glitch in Manilla's shield boost 
[*] Shorter stall time when climbing over Cracksom in his battle
[*] Slight framerate improvement in Abstractia level 5-4
[*] When Cracksom spins and damages Manilla, he steps back slightly to attack again
[*] Crackscorpio [i](Quantum City boss)[/i] can take double damage when his double shot is returned. 
[*] Manilla will no longer lose level 5-3 just by touching the "water" of the sea [i](at least until she sinks to a certain depth)[/i]
[*] Rol & Rogue's supercrits will appear a bit more frequently
[*] Gameboss fights will no longer be improperly triggered by pressing C/Select without first reaching their combat areas
[*] Minor fix for Manilla's sprites in Rol & Rogue
[*] Player Randy/Manilla can clip through Randy/Manilla CPU
[*] Fixed muted sound of Randy dying in level 3-1
[*] Level 1-2 signs are now destructible
[*] Fixed a detail when leaving Quantum City, entering Rol & Rogue, and then exiting to the start menu to load the game: some Net-Cubes that entered ended up as Rol & Rogue
[/list]

This is the Randy & Manilla patch with the most changes recorded to date. The idea behind this patch was to give the current Early Access the most polished version possible before we start the long road to the next major update [i](a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2881270/view/535463129771935618?l=english]preview[/url] of the characters making their debut was shown on the penultimate day of 2024)[/i].
I hope that what this patch offers will be worth your time while you wait for the next big update.

notes.title: A teaser for the next major update of Randy & Manilla
notes.content:
[b]2025[/b] is coming, and perhaps in the same year, one of the most important things that will coming to the game is shown in the following image:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/ee3e6e04a724e77f10cad86d68ff333bc321fd49.png[/img]

This pixelated image shows the silhouettes of a pair of mysterious characters that will appear in Randy and Manilla's next major update.
They are scheduled to be released at the earliest between mid and late 2025.
For those who don't know, this update is part of the first block on the roadmap:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/3a0f4ef153c6c32e1bab2bd8a5474a82c83eff23.png[/img]

But as I explained in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2881270/view/4473858302400266556?l=english]Quantum City update[/url], its development will be much longer and more ambitious. 
I hope your wait is worth it.

notes.title: A second but smaller patch for QC update
notes.content:
The patch that follows the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2881270/view/708851015406847021?l=english]previous one[/url] is very little in comparison, but with one highlight to close the year [b]2024[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/6866945df755a95b55a8fe730076d826645b16dc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/1088ac8ab17c14e6c2d5411ec1d1208f17ee4eb4.png[/img]

Most of the non-localized texts finally have a Spanish localization, including texts for images and re-recorded videos.
The exceptions in this patch are texts such as some of Wonder Race, whose fonts are a bit more complex to recreate. This complexity could increase if more languages are added to the game.

Among other small changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the points that don't count when making contact with the feet.
[*] Vertical rotation can now be reversed with B key.
[*] Softening of the zoom sensitivity for more precise adjustments.
[/list]

Until then, development will be on hold before the next patch or major update (which will probably come sometime in [b]2025[/b]).
Anyway, have a happy holiday and a happy new year ;)

notes.title: A patch for the Quantum City update!
notes.content:
On the way to major updates, there are a few patches to be released and this brand new one offers
the following changes and additions:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/e7d653434aae9c79e36acc54cdb830d0ade3eb55.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=n9IjLz-ZBL0;full][/previewyoutube]

If you are in an even bigger hurry to get through levels, especially the longer ones, an additional function has been added to the sprint button. However, like the sprint in Rol & Rogue, what it actually does is speed up time x2 while holding the button as the playable characters are moving.
The difference between this sprint and the one implemented for the other Net-Cubes is that it is activated after pressing the sprint button twice or walking after 3 seconds in a row and has a very limited time with a recovery period depending on the character chosen:

Randy's Super Sprint:
[list]
[*] Use time: 2 seconds (4 seconds in normal time)
[*] Recovery time: 4 seconds
[/list]
Manilla's Super Sprint:
[list]
[*] Use time: 3 seconds (6 seconds in normal time)
[*] Recovery time: 3 seconds
[/list]

The continuous use time may seem very short, but the idea of ​​this limitation is not to abuse the ability
and to use it in cases where there are large areas free of enemies and obstacles.

Among other changes and additions:

[b]Physical and gameplay changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Automatic camera rotation for controllers can be activated with the RT/R2 button.
[*] The physics, gravity and mobility of both Randy and Manilla were balanced.
[*] Vertical rotation can now be reversed with LT/L2.
[/list]
[b]Other changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Slight changes in the position of some locks in Rol & Rogue.
[*] Fixed a minor animation bug in dialogue triggers.
[*] More exaggerated effect on the icons indicating the targets to destroy in the fourth level challenges of both 
[*] Terra-Qubit and Quantum City.
[*] The color of the Golembrick's crowns (name of the first boss) was changed.
[*] Mouse blocking for clicking the character selection buttons in Rol & Rogue was fixed.
[*] Fixed (at least for the most part) a Golembrick animation bug that occurs in the third phase.
[*] Minor redesigns in some levels to adapt to the new character physics.
[*] Fixed the frozen animation of the exit buttons when quitting and re-entering the pause menu.
[*] Minor audio corrections.
[*] Minor sprite corrections in level 6-4.
[*] Minor level redesign in Gamezone Cube.
[*] Fixed quicktime effect when replay the boss battle from Wonder Race (Gyga Cy-Wasp).
[/list]

Even with all the additions, another patch could come after this one, but in the meantime, development will be soon on hold so you can have a happy holiday season and a new year 2025 with everything the game has to offer so far ;)

notes.title: The Quantum City Update is here!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=FcMSfI4vJno;full][/previewyoutube]
Originally, this new version was going to be the fourth patch, but, in addition to its long-awaited fixes, 
it also brings forward some of the new levels that were planned for the [b]first major update[/b].
Below is an explanation of everything that the next version offers and, further, the reasons behind these decisions:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/71e2477cb2dc147c61622c45124e886e627b5b67.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/1aaf7dba1724a00fc5ca4f0f2c47f50590527fb3.png[/img]
Firstly, Quantum City is now complete with two new levels. Among them, the debut of a new boss called "[b]Crackscorpio[/b]" stands out: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/873ad62ea513189654347af63a556970ab05721e.png[/img]
Sent by [b]Cracksom[/b] to steal the key that [b]Blue Quantáramo[/b] gave Randy and Manilla for their mission. One must have very good reflexes and timing to dodge the fast attacks of his tenacious pincers and shots.
In addition, two new compositions and another couple of remixes of pre-existing ones are included in the soundtrack.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/a1d359c6f6d88b5b9f2bb69f608fed4fa49679fc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/33d024f0bacdeaf070c987101c1faa8d36badbbb.png[/img]
This is great news if you are one of those players who likes to control Manilla better than Randy. 
Randy's sister is also playable in the [b]Rol & Rogue's [/b]Net-Cube, and the role of helper is played by Randy himself.
You can switch between characters using the character selection option both at the start and after losing the game. Additionally, there have also been some code updates to adapt it to Manilla's gameplay and some slight tweaks to the details of the levels.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/f94fc81fc978122929e286877d5d1f4daf8a93be.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=eSsawiCSo3k;full][/previewyoutube]
The footstep sounds, previously limited to cutcsenes, have also been included, in order to provide a wider sound immersion in the game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/437324230c7b3a4b75414198980d23fd7b199fc5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/ddcaddf7d057c123e50281aaf47ff9c61d80129c.png[/img]
If you have read the news of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2881270/view/4183360901863908403?l=english]first patch[/url], you will know that you can automatically sprint in 3 seconds. In addition to this, a visual indicator has been included to better clarify its activation (at least until you hit the manual run button).


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/6dadf14d5ccbdd2259308ef985e83ee2bdc26458.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/cc3791d2733e643527cd4bc037ad72a48f883336.png[/img]
Many of you who played the game, especially in the early stages, will remember how hard it was to steer your ship towards the Net-Cubes that are essential to the adventure. In case you find it more difficult than it should be, an "[b]auto-travel[/b]" option has been added to the main menu.
This is a help mode where, by simply pressing the speed button, your ship will head directly towards the selectable Net-Cubes. One less hassle for more casual or faster players.

Other improvements include:
[list]
[*] Ability to click on level buttons with the cursor in Quantum City
[*] Fixed tree collision at the goal in level 4-2
[*] Fixed collision micro-bug in level 1-5
[*] Minor fixes in Gamezone Cube
[*] A fix in the Net-Cubes menus in Rol & Rogue and Abstractia, where they could be skipped by pressing the exit button
[*] Fixed a teleport position in level 1-4
[*] New route added to the Quantum City map
[*] Minor modification to the pause menu
[*] The turn and move platform buttons will be disabled when they finish their function
[*] Removal of the running animation when falling from cracking bricks in level 1-3
[*] Moments where springs fail don't abruptly stop jumping (level 1-3)
[*] Randy is less prone to getting stuck in 2D levels
[*] Jumps in the air are limited by coyote time (2D levels)
[*] fixed the height and position of many Terra-Qubit trees, and also little level redesigns
[/list]

Now that all the changes, additions and improvements have been explained, let's see what they mean for the [b]roadmap[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/3a0f4ef153c6c32e1bab2bd8a5474a82c83eff23.png[/img]
As you can see, the blocks from the first and second update are marked with a vignette indicating that they are in progress or with content advancing, instead of being complete.
To better clarify the function of the vignettes, I explain it in the following image:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/2955a17d26192975eb4edbb5d0878128eaa22bd3.png[/img]

If the block vignettes are blank, it is because the blocks haven't yet been developed or are in draft phase, while, when they are marked with a tick, it means that all their base content is complete 
(not counting unforeseen imperfections or bugs).
But, returning to the changes in the roadmap, in the first one, where it says "[b]Quantum City and Blacksquare complete[/b]", there is a cyan asterisk indicating that it has been advanced in the current version.
Note: this is only referring to the fact that [b]Quantum City[/b] is complete, but [b]Blacksquare[/b] is not, although it can be accessed after leaving the aforementioned Net-Cube. It has remained since the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W3tQ-jPQO_o]beginning of development[/url], acting as a kind of "fake post-game" offering 3 levels in advance.

But the most important matter that both points indicate is that there will be changes to the voices of a couple of the most important characters in the game. I regret to announce the departure of the voices of [b]Randy Qubit[/b] and [b]E-Mailer[/b] from the project, whose artists have decided to prioritize and pursue other paths in their careers.
However, plans to replace dubbing are long-term decisions, so the door is always open to the actors should they wish to return. The option of using AI (artificial intelligence) to replace human voices is [b]NOT[/b] being considered, even though the game is obviously about AI, as the project started in a time before generative AI massification.

Because of all of the above, I ask for your patience for the first major update, which may arrive later than usual. However, the second update, having almost all of its simpler content in advance, will possibly be released earlier and will continue at the established pace.

Despite the bumps, I encourage you to continue enjoying everything that the game currently offers and will continue to offer. 
Their patches will also come and the demo has updated in parallel to everything described.

notes.title: Available now the 3rd patch!
notes.content:
Another patch had to come at the start of the big updates, as there were some bugs that went unnoticed or weren't included in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2881270/view/4258798098382550772?l=english]previous patch[/url], but we start with what it offers below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/9c9ea25b981d453c7a54b2f0e993570e287b578a.png[/img]

To begin with, it was taken into account that sometimes the rings that catapult don't work properly [i](specially when jumping when you are about to fall into the voids)[/i], and also because some weren't fixed correctly after the changes in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2881270/view/4183360901863908403?l=english]first patch[/url].
As if the missing fixes weren't enough, with one life left, all of them will be replaced by teleporters that just by stepping on them will take you from one place to another without running so much risk of losing the level due to intermittent rings failures [i](It is possible that in a future patch or update we will find out how to make the rings functional at 99.9%)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/241ecee32a89189d99106e512b4fed25683748da.png[/img]

Another case happens with healing points, but for another reason. Many who have played the game, upon reaching one of these points with 3 or more HP, will have wondered why they didn't work, and the answer is very simple: Randy or Manilla's HP was still full and will regain life once they receive damage.
To make it more visually understandable, the points will begin to go off, and will light up when they detect that they have received damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/a604be8fd1f66291a177b5670a8f810bbb4495ed.png[/img]

In Manilla's runner levels, a small screen has been included in the UI that predicts the next obstacle to jump [i](useful for those who don't have such good reflects)[/i], and the representative icon will change shape when the next one matches the shape from itself.

Among other changes and additions:

[b]Gameplay and physics changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an animation bug when stepping on a spring in Terra-Qubit 1-2.
[*]Punching and kicking animations from Randy and Manilla now have a transition from when they are in the air.
[*]Slightly increased double kick chance in Rol & Rogue.
[/list]

[b]Other changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Small height and texture fixes for certain enemies.
[*]The red screen is better integrated into the 2D levels.
[/list]

Up to this point, project development will be paused for vacation before starting a fourth patch or something like that. Anyway enjoy the game for what it offers so far :)

notes.title: Out now the 2nd patch!
notes.content:
In case you didn't know, it has announced a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2881270/view/4183360901864405440?l=english]roadmap[/url] along with the launch of a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2881270/view/4183360901863908403?l=english]patch[/url] that talked about three big updates that will come in the future.
But before starting the first of the big ones, a second patch has been released that doesn't add new features or redesign levels, but at least has renewed certain parts of the code, small additions and some small physics and gameplay improvements that They provide a slightly better experience.

The changes & add of the 2nd patch are the next:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/abf2406432704a897e9853cc9e1e6d7470ca0fad.png[/img]

In first place, If you complete the scores of levels 1-2 and 4-4, you can obtain the rare occasion of two temporal skills at the same time.

[b]Gameplay & physics changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]It is given greater mobility in the air.
[*]After colliding the springs, you can move more freely in the air, which allows you to avoid many undue falls into the void due to going in the wrong direction (especially in Terra-Qubit).
[*]The animations of Randy and Manilla being weak to only one HP has changed places, and there (almost)  aren't interruptions in jump power.
[*]For the ship, it won't switch from joystick and keyboard controls to mouse when it is moving.
[*]In level 4-2, the key input for Manilla's shield was changed, as it was inappropriately on the G key instead of E.
[/list]

[b]Other changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The small arrow on the Net-Cubes minimap is now a 3D model.
[*] Spelling microcorrections in Wonder Race.
[*] Racing levels lap counter starts with 1/4 instead of 0/4
[/list]

Another patch will possibly come before the big updates when needed, but you can still give this game a chance at what it currently offers.

notes.title: Early Access Patch of Randy & Manilla
notes.content:
Weeks after the Early Access release, and thanks to the feedback obtained by a small but not insignificant community, some of the following improvements and additions have been applied, which will be summarized below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/e78b59e039bdf2b0eb6dffc28aa5adb29642c81d.png[/img]
First of all, the levels of the Net-Cube Abstractia have been redesigned to be shorter or more concise for the challenges they propose. For example, level 5-1 now has a gigantic fuscia tree indicating the goal, but there are reach by means of teleporters to which three of them are the correct ones.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/30c7df9f73f7847b1f1d48155c4d3e942ba40f48.png[/img]
Also in the pause menu, a button has been included to return to the start menu without having to save the game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/eff2b3f7f6ee5d382e57432fc6c2758d9a86f127.png[/img]

And speaking of saving the game, a toggle has also been included to activate the autosave option to the right of the help buttons for the controls.

Among other things that were included:

[list]
[*] The FixedTime was reduced to 0.02 at 0.0166 for better performing on 60 Fps mode,
[*] and certain parts of the code that were affected by these changes were adapted.
[*] Sprint automatic activated after 3 seconds walking.
[*] The scroll of the graphics option in the pause menu can now be up and down with the right joystick of the controls.
[*] Checkpoints added in levels 1-4 & 2-5 Randy's phase.
[*] Some bugs & detail fixes.
[/list]

We hope that with everything included in the patch you have a better experience playing Randy & Manilla.

notes.title: The Early Access is out now! (Randy & Manilla)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/bfbd5faa9b5607c3d0d817cd875b91ce96745bd6.png[/img]

May 10th has already passed, and the Randy & Manilla´s Early Access is now available on Steam.
The early access comes with more than 30 levels spread across 7 different Net-Cubes, 
and among all those levels, they also offer the following things:
- 9 different mechanic types (3D Platformer, 2D Platformer, Arcade, Rogue-Lite, etc.)
- 6 boss battles
- +70 OST compositions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923015/cf12b6ec951f649278bd3d4e3a8b2df15f8a887d.png[/img]

After its release, a roadmap for the big updates will be revealed and will also include some patches if required.

For all those who want to play the game, enjoy it :)
